fields.description: Program Description 1. Traning Objectives Editor Note: The major also was awarded the international engineering certificate in 2019, demonstrating that the major is at a high level with international advance. This major aims to meet the needs of national modernization and regional economic and social development, cultivate applied senior professional and technical talents with all-round development of morality, intelligence, physique and beauty, who are competent for the design, construction, management, research, education, investment and development of various civil engineering projects, and have strong engineering quality, innovation awareness, practical ability, sustainable development potential and a certain international vision. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The courses listed below are not all the courses and they are only for reference. Theoretical mechanics, material mechanics, structural mechanics, soil mechanics, civil engineering drawing, civil engineering materials, concrete structure design, steel structure design, masonry structure design, foundation engineering design, building structure earthquake resistance, road survey design, subgrade and pavement engineering, bridge engineering, tunnel engineering, underground structure design, underground engineering disaster prevention and mitigation, civil engineering construction, surveying, housing architecture Project management, etc. 3. Employment Direction Editor Notes: Many of the gtaduates specializing in designing and exploring in civil engineering in Shandong Province graduated from the school. Graduates can engage in technical and management work in construction functional departments, infrastructure departments of enterprises and institutions, architectural or municipal engineering design institutes, scientific research institutes, construction enterprises, construction supervision and quality supervision departments, real estate companies, engineering cost consulting and investment institutions, and can apply for structural engineering, disaster prevention and mitigation and protection engineering, road and railway engineering, bridge and tunnel engineering, geotechnical engineering Graduate student in engineering mechanics and other related disciplines. You can get registered structural engineer, registered geotechnical engineer, registered constructor, registered supervisor and registered cost engineer. 4. Introduction of School of Civil Engineering Editor Notes: The school has become a training cradle for advanced talents with strong engineering practice capabilities in the economic construction, especially in the construction industry of Shandong Province. The School of Civil Engineering at Shandong Jianzhu University was founded in 1958, which primarily was the Department of Building Engineering at Shandong University of Architecture and Engineering. The School focuses its efforts on two bachelor disciplines, namely: civil engineering and urban underground space engineering, and a sub-discipline of civil engineering for internationally cooperative program. As of December 2021, the School has 149 employees, including 127 faculty members. The School currently has 2035 undergraduate students and 410 graduate students. It accepts 8 civil engineering classes, 2 urban underground space engineering classes and 3 classes of internationally cooperative program per year. 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: XJTU is a member of Chinese Ivy League Universities. Shandong Jianzhu University (SJU) is situated in Jinan, the beautiful capital city of Shandong Province, P. R. China. Shandong Province has a time-honored history and has served as a pivotal cultural and religious site for Taoism, Chinese Buddhism, and Confucianism. Shandong has emerged as one of the most populous and most affluent provinces in China. Jinan is also called "Spring City" and has a considerable number of tourist attractions such as Baotu Spring, Daming Lake and Qianfo Mountain. Learn More>> 6. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. Internships ​ Communicate with Enterprises ​ ​​

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. 2-inch photo * 2. Photocopy of passport(including personal information page and Chinese visa pages). * 3. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 4. High school academic transcript High school academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 5. English proficiency certificate * 6. Non-criminal record The applicant must submit a valid certificate of no criminal record issued by the local public security organization, which should be valid within six months from the application date. * 7. Proof of financial guarantee (1) Scanned copies of passport or identification document of the financial guarantor(limited to the applicant or immediate family member) (2) Proof of financial support, with deposits of no less than 20,000 RMB or an equivalent amount in foreign currency. * 8. Physical Examination Form Forms will be deemed invalid if they are incomplete, lack attached photos, do not have a cross-page seal on the photo, lack asignature of the attending physician, or are without an official hospital stamp. The validity period of the examination result is 6 months (it must be within the validity period during the time of application). You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. A Self-introduction Video -Pease send us a vdeo of 3-5 minutes replying the folowing questions (for bachelor degree applicants) -1.Please introduce yourself in the following aspects nationality, performance in high school in detail(how many years in high school in your country, how many subjects, overall performance, etc), favourite subjects, hobbies, etc, -2. What major do you apply? Why? -3. What's your plan after you get the bachelor degree? -4. Tell us about your family and also state your economic supply during the 4 years' study if you are admitted? -5. How much do you know the relationship between China and your mother country? -6. How much do you konw about the international business exchange(for business applicants)/infrastructure cooperation( for civil engineering application) between China and your mother country? Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Applicants must be citizens with a valid foreign passport, whose nationalities are not People's Republic of China. 18-25 years old. Those overseas applicants who were residents of Chinese mainland,Hong Kong,Macao and Taiwai must have held the valid foreign passport or certificates of nationality for at least four years, and over two years(nine-month actual residence in foreign countries within one year can be caltulated as one year,subject to the entry and exit date) of the actural foreign residence record within the last four years. Applicants for undergraduate programs should hold high school diploma or above. Applicants for English taught programs should provide IELTS or TOEFL test results or English Proficiency certificates. Thoese who complete high school or university courses in English should provide relevant evidence; English-speaking applicants do not need to provide proof of English Proficiency.
